title: 第九章 老张放飞自我第十章 岳不群的绝望
content_zh:
武当身为大派，产业无数，自然在各地有耳目。
老张下山后，十分高调。
除了对穿着不在意之外，他住最好的客栈，吃最美的食物。
要只是这些也就罢了。
关键是老张所过之处，遇到山匪便屠尽杀绝，碰到江湖败类则一剑斩之。
这哪里是即将年过百岁的泰山北斗，分明像刚刚学艺有成下山扬名立万的少年天才。
“师尊厉害。”莫声谷刚开始大惊，随之大喜，然后来到了宋远桥身边，讨好道，“大师兄，大兄，大哥，你看小弟整天在山上，无所事事，虚度光阴，容易消磨志气，不如下山走一趟？师尊他老人家年过百岁了，还要一个人行走江湖，吃不好，睡不好，这不是告诉别人我们不孝吗？”
“休想！”宋远桥哼了一声，“师尊交代过，谁也不准跟着。”
“大兄啊，那是师尊怕我们出现意外，可你别忘了，他已经是百岁老人了。尽管师尊很强，强得离谱，可人老不以筋骨为能啊。再说，外面有个阴天下雨，歹人下毒，那些早就视师尊为眼中钉的门派，要是设下陷阱，让师尊他老人家怎么应付？万一有个好歹，我们做弟子的百死难赎其罪啊！”莫声谷巧舌如簧，声情并茂，又梗着脖子，“大哥，为了师尊，为了我们武当，小弟也必须下山！”
“大师兄，不如让小、七师弟去跟着吧，好歹有个照应！”殷梨亭是一个老实孩子，立马劝道。
“这……”宋远桥迟疑，最终还是点头，但严肃道，“老七，你记住，下山后不能惹事。”
“你放心！”莫声谷大喜，“我这就去。早见到师尊，也早些安心。”
他匆匆离去。
宋远桥张了张嘴，摇头叹道：“老七这性子，猴急猴急的！”
林凡没插言。
七师兄说的很对，毕竟师尊年纪大了，万一有个好歹，那相当于武当的天塌了。
尽管他不认为会出现意外。
不说武力天下第一。
就是当年行走江湖的经验，也吃不了亏。
林凡照样喝了一碗药膳，回到通天院后，继续修炼五行拳。

几遍下来，浑身舒坦。
相比初来时，他已经强壮很多。
“小师叔，你真的很厉害。”宋青书一直看着，此时复杂道，“我修炼五行拳这么多年，也只是大成而已，可你才修炼十来天，还没有底子，就将五行拳参悟到了圆满。”
他有些吃味。
毕竟在山上，他一直是几位师叔口中的天才，没少被夸赞。
可现在看到林凡的进步，怎能不复杂。
“青书啊，我年岁大了些，见识广，阅历丰富，参悟起来容易很多。”林凡笑道。
不过他知道，五行拳看似基础筑基拳法，却蕴藏着五行妙理、阴阳之道，外炼皮肉，内淬脏腑。
易学难精。
没有一定的五行基础，很难取得大成就。
更别说悟出其中精髓了。
content_en:
Wudang is a large sect with countless industries, so it naturally has eyes and ears everywhere.
After Lao Zhang came down from the mountain, he was very high-profile.
In addition to not caring about his clothes, he stayed in the best inns and ate the most beautiful food.
That's all.
The key is that wherever Lao Zhang goes, he will kill all the bandits he encounters, and he will kill the scum of the world with a single sword.
This is Taishan Beidou who is about to turn 100 years old. He clearly looks like a young genius who has just come down from the mountain to become famous.
"Master is amazing." Mo Shenggu was shocked at first, then overjoyed, and then came to Song Yuanqiao and said to flatter him, "Senior brother, eldest brother, eldest brother, you see, I am spending my time in the mountains all day long, doing nothing and wasting my time. Why not take a trip down the mountain? Master, he is over a hundred years old, and he still has to travel around the world alone. He cannot eat well and cannot sleep well. Doesn't this tell others that we are unfilial?"
"Don't even think about it!" Song Yuanqiao snorted, "Master has told me that no one is allowed to follow."
"Brother, it's because Master is afraid of something happening to us, but don't forget, he is already a centenarian. Although Master is very strong, ridiculously strong, people don't rely on their bones and muscles. Besides, it's cloudy and rainy outside, and some people are poisoning. Those who have long regarded Master as a thorn in their side Pai, if Master sets a trap, how will he deal with it? If something goes wrong, we as disciples will never be able to redeem ourselves!" Mo Shenggu spoke eloquently and spoke with emotion, "Brother, for the sake of Master and our Wudang, I must go down the mountain!"
"Senior Brother, why don't we let Junior and Seventh Junior Brothers follow us? At least we will have someone to take care of us!" Yin Liting, an honest child, immediately advised him.
"This..." Song Yuanqiao hesitated, and finally nodded, but said seriously, "Old Qi, remember, you can't cause trouble after going down the mountain."
"Don't worry!" Mo Shenggu was overjoyed, "I'll go right away. The sooner I see Master, the sooner I can feel at ease."
He left in a hurry.
Song Yuanqiao opened his mouth, shook his head and sighed: "Lao Qi's temper is as impatient as a monkey's!"
Lin Fan didn't interrupt.
The seventh senior brother is right. After all, the master is old. If something goes wrong, it will be equivalent to the collapse of Wudang.
Although he doesn't think there will be any surprises.
Not to mention that he is the best in the world in terms of force.
Even the experience of traveling in the world can't be lost.
Lin Fan drank a bowl of medicinal food as usual, returned to Tongtianyuan, and continued to practice Five Elements Boxing.
After several times, I feel comfortable all over.
He is much stronger than when he first arrived.
"Uncle Master, you are really amazing." Song Qingshu kept watching and said complexly, "I have practiced Five Elements Boxing for so many years, and I have only achieved great success. But you have only practiced Five Elements Boxing for ten days, and you have no foundation yet, and you have reached perfection in Five Elements Boxing."
He has some taste.
After all, in the mountains, he had always been a genius in the eyes of several master uncles and was often praised.
But now seeing Lin Fan's progress, how could it not be complicated.
"Qingshu, I'm a little older and have a lot of knowledge and experience. It's much easier for me to understand." Lin Fan said with a smile.
However, he knew that Five Elements Boxing seemed to be a basic foundation-building boxing technique, but it actually contained the wonderful principles of the Five Elements and the Tao of Yin and Yang, which could refine the skin and flesh on the outside and the internal organs on the inside.
Easy to learn but hard to master.
Without a certain foundation of the five elements, it is difficult to achieve great achievements.
Let alone understand the essence of it.
